A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UNREAL study. Full text and rendered-page comparisons cover the main text, Appendices A-L, and checklist, with no material gaps preventing comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original node-classification experiments in Section 5, additional graph and image-classification results in Appendix I, and ablations in Appendix J.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and the supplementary experiments and ablations in Appendices I-J.

M1.justification: UNREAL's pseudo-label alignment, RBO-based node reordering, and DGIS filtering procedures are unchanged in Section 4 and Algorithm 1. Removing an overclustering citation does not alter the method.

E1.justification: All dataset and task coverage is retained, including the main graph benchmarks and Appendix I's ogbn-products, CIFAR100LT, Chameleon, Squirrel, and Wisconsin experiments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding main and appendix experiments, including GraphSR, BIM, SCR, ConsisGAD, and M3S. GraphSR's citation changes from [72] to [71] through renumbering.

E3.justification: Data splits, imbalance settings, metrics, architectures, training budgets, and testing procedures are unchanged in Section 5.1 and the experimental appendices.

E4.justification: The geometric-imbalance analyses, component ablations, ranking dynamics, hyperparameter sensitivity tests, reduced-round experiments, and runtime analyses are retained unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices E-F, I, and J.

E5.justification: Section 5.1 retains five repetitions with standard-error reporting. Appendix I.3 retains means and standard deviations over five runs with different random seeds. Other appendix uncertainty disclosures are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, rankings, and plotted findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 2 retains Cora/GCN results at rho = 10 of 78.33 ± 1.04 balanced accuracy and 76.44 ± 1.06 F1.

T1.justification: Definitions 1-3, Theorems 1-3, their proofs in Appendices C, D, and H, and the complexity analysis in Appendix I.6 are unchanged. The citation edits do not revise mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometric imbalance, its relationship to uncertainty and class imbalance, and UNREAL's effectiveness.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of experimental results are unchanged. The discussions of clustering choice, computational costs, applicability, and future link-prediction work are also retained.

D1.justification: Appendix K retains the same implementation instructions, hyperparameter ranges, training schedules, and hardware specifications. Algorithm 1 and the project/code links are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 removes v2's bibliography entries [70], Hyperbolic and spherical embeddings for long-tail entities, and [74], Spectral contrastive graph clustering, together with their citations in the Section 3 and Section 4.1 footnotes. The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The author block drops Liang Yan's MBZUAI affiliation marker, and the footnote stating partial completion at MBZUAI is removed. Corresponding-author symbols and reference/footnote numbering change, while scientific prose and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their formatting and placement. Removing an author footnote and two bibliography entries produces localized spacing and reflow on the first and final reference pages, with a small footnote wrapping change on page 3.

improvement.justification: The revision preserves the methods, proofs, experimental evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information. The author-footnote edits, two removed background references, and local reflow have limited effects; the affected background statements retain other citations. Overall scientific support and clarity are materially unchanged.
